title: 3BR 30A Beach Home in Seagrove Beach with a Private Pool
meta_description: Stay at Coastal Living, a 3BR, 2.5BA 30A vacation home in Seagrove Beach with a private heated pool, a screened-in patio, and a full kitchen. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: Coastal Living is a luxurious 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom home located in beautiful Seagrove Beach. Coastal Living is carved out in an exclusive neighborhood off 395, directly north of 30A, and is conveniently nestled between the popular communities of Watersound, Seaside, and Watercolor. With only a little more than a quarter mile separating you from the Gulf, you’re only a short walk from the white-sanded beaches and crystal blue water. Not to mention, you are less than a mile from fun family activities, delicious restaurants, and desirable boutiques in the surrounding communities.This beautifully inspired home is just what you found yourself needing for your family vacation. Perfect for families or couples on a single floor plan with plenty of privacy for all.- Master Suite with TV, full bathroom (jetted tub and walk-in shower), and 2 large walk-in closets to accommodate the lengthiest of stays!- Corner Queen bedroom with TV and shared hallway bathroom- Shared bathroom for guest bedrooms with shower/tub combo - perfect for the little ones!- Corner Queen bedroom with shared hallway bathroom- Additional queen air mattress in closet- Generous living room with ample seating and viewing- Large kitchen with granite countertops and accessories for home cooking or dining in!Stepping out from the generous living area, you enter onto a large screened in patio, providing easy and comfortable relaxation to enjoy your morning coffee or evening dinners, and made complete with an easily accessible grill. Conveniently connected to the family room, you will find the 2nd and 3rd guest bedrooms. Each corner bedroom is outfitted with a queen bed.You will find all that you need in this well appointed home, outfitted with 3 TV's and high speed internet, and the kitchen is fully stocked. The dining table seats 4 comfortably with additional seating at the kitchen countertop for any family meal! Enjoy the provided kayak as well!With its beautiful woodland surroundings, spacious screened in patio overlooking the pool, modern interior, and gorgeous private pool – you and your guests are sure to have an amazing and memorable trip!Your stay at Coastal Living comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed* Parking for 4 cars.* Benchmark cannot guarantee/service owner-provided amenities* Pool heat can be added for an additional feeA Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
